translations.web: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”
translations.bsb: But others replied, “These are not the words of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”
translations.kjv: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
translations.asv: Others said, These are not the sayings of one possessed with a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?
